The Impugned Order has to stand on its own legs. The Hon’ble Supreme Court in _Mohinder Singh Gill_ v. _Chief Election Commissioner, New Delhi & Ors._ reported as (1978) 1 SCC 405,has held that when a statutory functionary makes an order based on certain grounds/ reasoning, its validity must be judged by the reasons so mentioned and cannot be supplemented by fresh reasons in the form of affidavits or otherwise.
